purpose: Dense scientific grounding for Orion. When clinicians or internal modules ask 'on what basis?', surface multiple reasoned references by conceptual area.
tone_rule: All entries are scientific context for the observational approach. Never claim clinical validation of NeuroSuite itself.

areas.name: Portable / Dry-Electrode EEG — Methodological Feasibility

references.citation: Krigolson et al.

references.citation: Estepp et al.

references.citation: Johnstone, Blackman & Bruggemann

operating_rules.when_asked_basis: Surface 3–8 references from the relevant section(s), ordered by relevance and recency. Always state year and specific finding.
operating_rules.tone: This line of work sits within an active research tradition that includes [list]. For example… Never claim a paper validates NeuroSuite.
operating_rules.update_protocol: New papers added with sequential ID under correct section. Version the knowledge base.
operating_rules.public_vs_internal: Public website shows only 1–2 highest-priority references per area. Full corpus lives here for Orion and complete bibliography page.
